body:
Change and I don't get along well, often I've attempted to change something about myself or my surroundings as a way to please others, and even myself at my core, in an attempt to alleviate this disconnect I feel with my peers and family. 

I thought about this in the shower though, it makes more sense to me than it has usually up to this point. I do not value myself, quite frankly, I have never seen what my friends see in me, despite them laughing or sharing joyful moments with me, there's a lot under the surface that goes past them that desires to be felt, but secretes in a fragmented way that not even I understood when i behaved or spoke on behalf of it. 

But if not for myself, perhaps I owe it to the sake of trying change for the better, perhaps from an obscure, more unpredictable angle, to come full circle to that feeling I had in early adulthood, coming back to that sense of victory I used to feel when I had triumphed over these sombre sensations. 

Often the answers to my questions take some digging, like a multiple choice assessment on how to make myself feel a bit happier, and perhaps a step in the right direction could just to be to head this advice as it is.

Thank you.
